scope: ClearNoon observable lamp crops plus explicit unobservable class; not hidden actor phase from back-facing lamps
augmentation: training brightness/contrast 0.9 to 1.1; fixed GT box crops, no crop jitter or flips. Joint evaluation uses detector boxes to expose localization shift.
selection: maximum validation macro recall, earliest tie
joint_evaluation: At fixed detector score>=0.5 and IoU>=0.5, match each visible lamp once; report correct phase / all GT visible lamps including detector misses
confidence_note: Maximum softmax is uncalibrated, not a safety probability
heldout_coverage_note: Original main dynamic lockbox lacks yellow phase coverage; pre-score frozen stationary Town02 supplement repairs phase coverage. No supplementary training. Dynamic/controlled results separately retained; thresholds unchanged.
